# dsh-hermes-facade

Makes your local **DeepSeek Harness** look like a **hermes-webui** server, so the
free, MIT-licensed

iOS app **Hermex**
(4.7 stars, App Store) can drive your agent from an iPhone or iPad: sessions,
st

reaming replies, thinking, tool cards, approvals and clarifications, in native
SwiftUI instead of a

eplies, thinking, tool cards, approvals and clarifications, in native
SwiftUI instead of a web view.
Hermex (iOS)  --HTTPS/SSE-->  tailscale serve :9443  -->  127.0.0.1:9120

dsh-hermes-facade
| in-process
dsh typertGateway
## Why a facade and not a fork

Hermex is a client, not a protocol. Its main app speaks the **hermes-webui**
HTTP+SSE contract; a se

parate JSON-RPC gateway stack is used only by the Bot
screens. Impersonating the *webui* host is the

refore the smallest possible
change: no Xcode, no App Store listing, no fork to maintain, and the Ap

p Store
app keeps updating itself.

The facade is a DSH host plugin. It owns one loopback port, translates between
the two wire formats,

and never touches dsh's own port-3080 origin (which is
already public through Tailscale Funnel, and

whose /api is dsh's own fenced RPC
namespace).
## Install
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hermes-facade

Then add the package to the profile bundle list in
~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json:
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "... existing ...", "dsh-hermes-facade" ] } }
Restart the host so the plugin loads:
dsh web
The first boot prints a generated password once:
hermes-facade: FIRST RUN password = xxxxxxxxxxxx

It is stored hashed at ~/.dsh/hermes-facade/password.json (0600). To reset it,
delete that file and

ored hashed at ~/.dsh/hermes-facade/password.json (0600). To reset it,
delete that file and restart.
## Expose it to the phone
Tailnet only, never Funnel:

tailscale serve --bg --https=9443 http://127.0.0.1:9120     # webui contract
tailscale serve --bg --

https=9444 http://127.0.0.1:9121     # Hermes contract
tailscale serve status

The second rule is only useful once you add the Hermes-protocol listener below as
a **separate serve

r** on the phone: the app decides a server's kind once, from
`GET /api/status`, so one URL cannot be

the phone: the app decides a server's kind once, from
`GET /api/status`, so one URL cannot be both.

In Hermex: **Add server**, URL = https://<machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net:9443,
password = the one from fi

password = the one from first boot.
Remove the exposure with:
tailscale serve --https=9443 off      # NOT 'serve reset': that also kills Funnel and :8443
## Reaching it from the phone

Three addresses work, all plain HTTP except the last. Hermex permits insecure
HTTP to local-network

hosts and to the Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10 range, so no
certificate is needed for the first two.
| Where | URL |

| same Wi-Fi | http://<mac-lan-ip>:9120 |
| Tailscale, plain HTTP (no DNS, no TLS) | http://<mac-tai

lscale-ip>:9120 |
| Tailscale, HTTPS through serve | https://<machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net:9443 |
Find the addresses with:

ipconfig getifaddr en0      # Wi-Fi LAN address
tailscale ip -4             # Tailscale address

The LAN and Tailscale listeners exist because cordis.patch.yml sets
lanHost: auto. Without it the fa

cade is loopback-only and only the serve rule

## What is supported
| Surface | State |

| health, auth (password + signed cookie) | full |
| session list, session detail, history | full: n

ewest 200 + 50-message scroll-back pages within the newest 800 |
| session search | full: id, messag

e-content and title matches, content matches with an excerpt; empty queries are empty results |
| ch
at telemetry | full: live `session.usage` plus `usage` on `message.complete` (context used/max, inpu

t/output tokens); **no cost** — DSH has no pricing |
| chat start / SSE stream / cancel / stream sta
tus | full; a failed or cancelled turn ends the stream with `error`/`cancel` instead of `done`; the

Legacy start body's `profile` is ignored (attachments are staged on the Hermes listener) |
| token d
eltas, thinking, tool cards | full: live and reloaded transcripts carry tool results, error verdicts

and durations |
| approvals (once / session / always / deny) | full: a reconnect keeps command/desc
ription, expired prompts answer `409 {"stale":true}` and are retracted. `session`/`always` are stand

ing grants keyed by tool name (no command-pattern allowlist) |
| clarifications / agent questions |

full: live and re-attached cards carry `question`/`choices_offered` and answer correctly |
| reasoni

ng effort | full: levels come from the model catalog |
| model picker | full: applied through `sessi

on/selectModel`; the catalog id/provider is resolved and the reasoning effort carried over |
| live
model overlay / providers | full (derived): both read the DSH model catalog; providers is read-only

|
| workspaces | partial: list only; add/remove/rename/reorder refused or 404 |
| workspace file bro

wser (`/api/list`, `/api/file`) | full: read-only |
| in-chat Files on the Hermes listener (`/api/fs

/*`) | read-only: listing, 512 KiB text preview, binary downloads, fenced to the chat folder |
| in-
chat Git on the Hermes listener (`/api/fs/git-root`, `/api/git/*`) | status, changes, diffs, branche
s, sha; stage/unstage/revert, commit, push and branch switch; every write refuses with 409 while a t

urn runs; credential files filtered and refused |
| profiles (DSH has agent presets, not profiles) |

partial: one static profile |
[该节后续省略]
## Security

* binds 127.0.0.1 only; reachable solely through the serve rule you add
* password: scrypt, constant

-time compare, 5 attempts / 15 min per address
* cookie: HMAC-signed, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure

when served over TLS
* the facade acts as an owner peer inside dsh, so remote-access rules do not
a
pply; the cookie is the boundary. Do not widen the bind address.
